# 4PL Academy

> 4PL Academy is the education and training arm of 4PL Consultancy Ltd. Its learning pathways cover artificial intelligence, digital transformation, logistics, supply chain management and professional training.

## Programs and learning

- [Degree programs](/programs): Current undergraduate and postgraduate program listings.
- [Professional courses](/professional-courses): Professional course information.
- [Universities](/universities): Directory information for Vivekananda Global University, IBMR Group of Institutions and Sushant University.
- [Certifications](/certifications): The academy's published certification information.
- [Student life](/student-life): Practical learning and student-life information.
- [Blogs](/blogs): Published articles and insights.

## About and contact

- [About 4PL Academy](/about): The academy's background, expertise and approach.
- [Contact us](/contact): Current office and contact details, and the enquiry form.
- [Counselling requests](/book-counselling): Request a preferred date and time in India Standard Time; appointments are confirmed by the team.
- [Partner with us](/partner-with-us): University and industry collaboration enquiries.
- [Careers](/careers): Work opportunities and careers enquiries.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](/privacy)
- [Terms and conditions](/terms)
